limits: A rating is ★ coaching over ◆ inputs; the score never gates. The floor (bracket_report.json) is the only bracket gate.
calibrate.py refuses a verdict below 10 decks with 20 games each; no figure here is checked against outcomes yet (`rating --calibrate` reports the refusal with today's n).
Goldfish kill is one column, never the rule: the benchmark is an unopposed ceiling with no blockers and no removal, and a combo or control deck reads slow for not attacking.
Forge is not a power read until the harness work is done (the pilot's rule, 2026-10-18): its component ships at weight 0.00 and is shown only for a run on the current list.
DeckCheck's Threat Index is shown in `context` and never scored.
Diagnostic engine figures are read against each deck's own declaration and are never ranked across decks; they are evidence for the argument, not a component.
rank over n=3 decks; no significance claim

open_questions.question: Is a bracket-4 clock the right anchor for a two-commander wheel deck whose payoff is hand-refill rather than a kill?
Does adding ramp and cheap removal lift the list over the current one, paired on the same seeds?

findings.note: validate-rating OK; rating sharknado --json reproduces components, withheld, code_score (61.8), bracket and limits identically.
log:001 'he got removed a couple times and then the tax came on' is verbatim and is the pilot's account of Brallin being removed; it matches the argument.
log:001 'it's a nine drop' is the pilot's four+five commander unit; used as claimed.
log:001 'the first game was good' is the opening of the entry; the entry result is None, so the argument's 'no logged result' is accurate.
stack:003 checker verdict is pass; the quote is the stack title and the argument claims only a rules fact about Brallin and cycling discard, not an engine win.
skeleton:speed kill_by_turn_8 0.889 [0.8827,0.895] n=10000 matches the component input; skeleton:resilience answer_cards=11 matches.
Every strategy quote (power-level, mana-base, interaction-suite, ratios, threat-density) is a verbatim substring of its section and is used for what the section says.
'The goldfish never removes a commander' is recorded in goldfish.py model notes: 'Commander tax, death and recasting are still not modelled: it is cast once and it stays.' No unrecorded claim found.

62 vs code_score 61.8 is a claim of no gap; I found no figure in the record (rate, count, game) arguing the number should move. The single logged game has no result, so neither direction has a named figure. Nothing to mark too-generous or too-harsh.
'Top of bracket 4' for speed and mana is the placement of 100 within n=3 and is stated that way; no unbounded superlative.
Both are unanswered by the skeleton: whether a bracket-4 clock fits a two-commander wheel deck is a diagnose question; whether ramp plus cheap removal lifts the list is a paired goldfish try.

resolution: the interval spans 0 grade boundaries; measured components carry their inputs' intervals, the judgment none

judgment.argument: The measured components cannot see a played deck: no scored games, no survey, no Forge run on this list, and the goldfish has no blockers or removal. I fill in two things only. One is unmeasured and pulls down: two commanders play as one unit the table can tax, and no instrument models that. The goldfish never removes a commander, so kill_by_turn_8 of 0.889 assumes both arrive and stay. The pilot's account is "he got removed a couple times and then the tax came on", and together they are "a nine drop". The other is unscored and pulls up: the same log says "the first game was good". I do not charge the thin answer suite or the grindy ending again, since resilience already prices them. The speed and mana components sit at the top of bracket 4, and one game with no logged result gives me no ground to say the list is better or worse than they read. Stack 003 passed its checker on cards the list runs: it is a rules fact about Brallin and a cycling discard, not evidence the engine wins. The unmeasured cost and the unscored positive are each real and each lightly recorded, so they cancel and I sit at the measured score of 61.8, rounded to 62: the components already say it, and one game is too little to move me off them.
